title: Track 3 covert-compute certificate model
basis: Implements a transparent sampling-bound model corresponding to the public AI 2040 Appendix B logic; it does not produce a treaty certificate by itself.
zero_failure_bound: For a zero-failure sample, the reference upper-bound form is approximately D <= (tail/n) * ln(1/delta), subject to the model's sampling assumptions.
failure_model: When failures are observed, compute an upper confidence bound on the failure proportion using an explicit one-sided binomial calculation and multiply by the tail population.
limitations: Finite-population corrections are not automatically applied.
The model requires a genuinely closed tail population to support a real certificate.
It does not validate source data, ownership claims, or physical inspections.
